description: Search the robot directory at geppettorobotdirectory.com for 140+ robot hardware component suppliers by component category, country, or keyword. Returns name, slug, component category, country, public-listing/stock code, and bottleneck risk.

component.description: Component category slug, e.g. reducers, motors, sensors

country.description: Country the supplier is in, as a full name or ISO-2 code: China/CN, Japan/JP, Germany/DE, United States/US, Switzerland/CH, Taiwan/TW, Sweden/SE, Australia/AU

query.description: Free-text search over supplier name and component description

name: search_suppliers
title: Search Component Suppliers
